dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings with high-contrast perimeters. The geometry features jagged transitions from light exterior margins to dark central cores. Primary structures along the dorsal-midline exhibit non-continuous boundaries with sharp pixel-intensity gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of low-intensity (dark) solid-pixel clusters localized within the centers of annular rings. Sparse distribution of small, high-intensity (light) solid pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated on the posterior cranial region and the lower lateral margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-midline annuli form an obtuse, nearly linear geometric relationship with an internal angle of approximately 165 degrees. Connecting these to the primary lateral 'C' shape centroid forms a narrow scalene triangle on the upper flank.
